verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms PagerDuty serves a live llms.txt file with structured knowledge-base documentation (HTTP 200), which is exactly the artifact an AI agent would target, and this is corroborated by extensive agent-oriented developer docs (official MCP server, REST/Events APIs) supporting agentic consumption. Missing for 10: independent/third-party confirmation that an agent has successfully parsed and acted on the llms.txt file, and evidence of additional agent-oriented doc formats beyond the single llms.txt endpoint.
